* '''PC-E1''' ([[The Force Will Be With You, Always (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages; publisher edition line “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”).</ref>, page 5, October 2026 edition: “If a Jedi 'communing,' choose: ▲ Coruscant: Jedi Temple. OR Once per game, draw bottom card of your Force Pile. OR Once per game, take your just drawn destiny into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[The Force Will Be With You, Always]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[The Force Will Be With You, Always]] (repository revision dated 9 October 2026) as a printable slip under the label “•The Force Will Be With You, Always”; the printed game text matches the card image.  '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
